list_total.inputContract: A shared read-only list of at most six integers from -1000 to 1000; 0 <= index <= len(values).
design: One-call promise
Return the sum of the existing list from index onward.
Direct base answer
At index == len(values), the remaining suffix is empty: return 0 before indexing.
Decreasing measure
len(values) - index decreases. The index increases; the remaining problem gets smaller.
Delegated call
Ask list_total(values, index + 1) to total the remaining suffix of the same list.
Caller’s combination
Add this call’s values[index] to its own received child_total, then return total.
list_total.complexity: For m remaining elements: m + 1 invocations and peak frames, including the base call. O(m) work and O(m) additional call stack under the bounded-integer model. The list is shared; no suffix lists are allocated. Iteration is often simpler for a flat list.

wrong_base.label: Repair · wrong base result
wrong_base.explanation: The first divergence is the base call preparing 1. An empty suffix contributes 0; the legal Python execution adds the extra 1 to the final result.

missing_combine.label: Repair · missing combination
missing_combine.repair: Return total, including this caller’s current value.
missing_combine.explanation: The first non-base call computes total = 1, then returns child_total = 0. Its calculated local and returned expression differ. The program completes normally with the wrong result.

print_instead_of_return.label: Repair · print instead of return
print_instead_of_return.repair: Replace print(total) with return total inside the function.
print_instead_of_return.explanation: The first non-base call prints 1, then implicitly returns None. Its caller binds None to child_total; adding an integer to None raises a real TypeError. Printing does not return an answer.

no_progress.label: Repair · no progress
no_progress.repair: Pass index + 1 so the remaining length decreases.
no_progress.explanation: The first child receives the same index 0 and same list. The base case exists but is never reached. The external teaching guard stops at eight live functions; this is not Python’s recursion limit.
no_progress.exportWarning: Intentionally nonterminating example. Do not run this exported driver without an external depth/time limit.

folder_total.inputContract: A synthetic acyclic tree of at most 16 distinct nodes, depth at most six; files contain 0 to 10000 bytes. No filesystem access or shared subtrees.
design: One-call promise
Return the total file bytes underneath one supplied synthetic node.
Direct base answer
A file returns its own bytes. An empty folder initializes total = 0, skips its loop, and returns 0.
Decreasing measure
Each child belongs to a smaller subtree of this finite acyclic hierarchy.
Delegated call
Ask total_size(child) for one child’s total; siblings run sequentially in source order.
Caller’s combination
Assign the returned value to this caller’s child_total, then add it to this caller’s total.
folder_total.complexity: For N nodes and hierarchy height H: O(N) work and O(H) additional call stack under the bounded-value model. The full input hierarchy and inspection history are visualization storage, separate from the algorithm’s live call stack.
